newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean parliament passes new labour law.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean parliament passes new labour law.

text.p: South Korea's parliament on Monday passed a new labour bill to replace a law that sparked nearly one month of strikes after it was rammed through last December, witnesses said.
The new law, composed of four sections, delays for two years a clause that set off worker fury by making it easier for companies to lay off staff.
It was cobbled together in a hasty compromise between the ruling New Korea Party and two opposition groups.
The earlier law unleashed some of the worst industrial unrest in South Korean history after it was forced through parliament with no debate on December 26.
President Kim Young-sam was forced to return the law to the National Assembly.
